segments.contextAfter: `flag`: If [`true`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Swift/true), the first event will be generated when the cursor leaves `aRect`, regardless if the cursor is inside `aRect` when the tracking rectangle is added. You usually want to set this flag to [`false`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/Swift/false).
